I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message, confirming the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November and that no action is needed.

I also saved the date to the gbrain knowledge brain as a fact with her message as the source, since she asked for it "for your records." A brain search turned up no other renewal date for Brackenwater, though search is keyword-only right now, so that isn't proof none exists.

The brain doesn't record a year for the renewal. I took it as the next 25 November after the message date, which is 2026. Ilse may want to confirm that year.
